Method of Attack: path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the expected document root
remote code execution if the mod_cgi module was loaded and the default 'Require all denied' option was missing
Discoverer: Fernando Muñoz from NULL Life CTF Team
Attack Vector: path traversal attack exploiting incomplete patch in Apache HTTP Server
requests to files outside document root not protected by 'require all denied'
CGI scripts enabled for aliased paths
Indicators of Compromise: over 112,000 Internet-exposed and vulnerable Apache HTTP servers
